LESSON: ANGLES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: GEOMETRY 3.1 POSITION AND DIRECTION (4 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand, th
Topic 3.2: ANGLES
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers ANGLES, part of GEOMETRY 3.1 POSITION AND DIRECTION (4 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand, th in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can you find angles in the environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on ANGLES together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: as learners in groups are guided to discuss and recognize angles that are

made by 2 lines that meet at point using a chart with different lines.

● Learning to learn: as learners make clockwise quarter and half turns and relate the turns to angles.

Values

● Responsibility: as learners explore and identify angles from the objects such as cubes, cuboids in the environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

● Environmental education: as learners explore regular objects within their environment and measure their

angles.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate angles from objects such as cubes and cuboids in the environment to perspective in Creative Arts.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Models of different angles, print outs, relevant digital devices
